outcome: Neonatal outcomes (birth weight, gestational age, need for neonatal intensive care unit admission, mortality)
cohort: 44 neonates born to 41 COVID-19-positive mothers in North India
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy did not have direct adverse effects on the fetus, and the possibility of vertical transmission was found to be negligible in this study.
birth_weight: Data on birth weight provided for each infant (29.5% had low birth weight)
